consumer: The carry-threshold objective check asking 'does the avatar carry >= 250 units of water_clean?', which an engine count predicate (e.g. charges_of/amount_of over carried inventory) answers.
scope: The avatar's full reachable carried inventory including charges nested inside worn/wielded/inventory containers, summed across partial stacks.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items dumps raw wielded/worn/inv_const_slice items with charges but never recurses into container contents and computes no count, so it is class-S raw state, not the class-C count the goal needs.
divergence: Avatar carries a sealed canteen holding 300 units of water_clean: the engine count predicate reports >=250 (true), but the raw dump emits only the canteen as one inventory item (its nested water charges are not descended into), so re-deriving from the snapshot yields 0 units and a false negative.
